Chapter 840: Chapter 32 I’ll Wait for You on the Eleventh Step (Please Subscribe)

“My current mental will is too strong; even the strongest beings can sense it with just a slight perception,” thought Lin Yuan as he sat cross-legged on the Milky Way Main Star.

This was one of the drawbacks of a rapidly improving mental will—his realm had yet to catch up.

“However, once I step into the Eleventh Rank, things should get much better.”

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

After stepping into the Eleventh Rank, Lin Yuan’s physical soul body’s inner world would undergo another significant leap forward.

At that time, it’s estimated that he could barely withstand the pressure of over thirty-three million units of mental will.

...

Unless Lin Yuan made a full effort and deliberately exposed himself,

It would be tough for even the strongest beings to detect any anomalies in his mental will.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan met with his parents, casually chatting.

“Xiaoyuan, your sister and brother-in-law also came over,” Lu Qiong, his mother, received the news and looked at Lin Yuan.

“Mmm, let them come over,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Ever since his sister Lin Yi married Xia Keran, he seldom saw them.

Soon.

Lin Yi and Xia Keran appeared.

“Greetings, Galaxy Master.”

Facing Lin Yuan, Xia Keran was still extremely respectful.

Since marrying Lin Yi, Xia Keran had clearly felt his status within the Xia Family rise more than just a notch.

Originally, Xia Keran was just an ordinary direct descendant of the Xia Family. With the scale of Human the Xia Family, there were at least hundreds of thousands, if not a million such direct descendants.

They had a certain status and no worries about food and drink, but that was all.

With the identity of a direct descendant of the Xia Family, Xia Keran could lead a carefree life, but the possibility of reaching a high position was virtually non-existent.

Who knew how many were in line ahead of him.

But merely by being with Lin Yi, Xia Keran received a summons from that Eleventh Rank old ancestor of the Xia Family.

After the two married, Xia Keran was directly admitted into the core of the Xia Family and even had the hope of becoming the next head of the Xia Family.

The head of the Xia Family was a significant figure in human civilization, of great importance. This was a position Xia Keran did not even dare to dream of before.

However, Xia Keran had a very clear understanding of himself.

All of his current changes in status and identity originated from the Galaxy Master.

Without the Galaxy Master, he Xia Keran would have been just one of the numerous, insignificant direct descendants of the vast Human the Xia Family.

“Mmm.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly, quite satisfied with Xia Keran.

At the very least, the man was truly sincere towards Lin Yi. With Lin Yuan’s current privileges as a Level Nine citizen, Xia Keran had almost no privacy in front of him.

The family chatted for a while.

Then Lin Yuan stood up and left.

“The outside world says that the Galaxy Master has the highest talent in our human civilization. But who knows that apart from cultivation, the Galaxy Master has no other interests.”

It was not until Lin Yuan left that Xia Keran finally relaxed a bit. He didn’t know why, but every time he saw the Galaxy Master, he was incredibly nervous, not even daring to breathe too loudly.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, three months had gone by.

Virtual World, that segment of the body still hovered above the sky.

Lin Yuan slowly emerged from the state of contemplation, “These three months, I have thoroughly understood over two million demonic evolutionary pathways, and there are no more for me to deduce.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The body he was contemplating at the moment was just a projection after all, naturally not containing as much information as the actual body itself.

“Well, I should make a trip to the thirteenth forbidden zone.”

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan opened his eyes and split off a strand of mental will, forming an avatar that immediately disappeared on the spot.

With Lin Yuan’s current mental will strength, even a temporarily conjured avatar could easily wield Eleventh Rank battle power.

This is the advantage of strong mental will.

An avatar of the strongest being can also exert battle power far above the Eleventh Rank.

Whoosh.

The avatar Lin Yuan conjured up left the Milky Way Star Region in the blink of an eye.

“Space-time…”

The strong mental will meant that this avatar could utilize most of Lin Yuan’s rule perception, including the Sixth Realm of space-time.

Therefore, when it came to traveling, it was undoubtedly the fastest existence beneath the strongest beings in current human civilization.

Of course, this fastest is based on the premise that other human civilization evolvers do not rely on external forces for travel.

Relying solely on his own power and rule perception, Lin Yuan believed that no Eleventh Level Perfected Evolver could exceed this avatar of his.

One month later.

Lin Yuan smoothly arrived at the thirteenth forbidden zone.

As a critical location of human civilization, any citizen entering this place would need to undergo strict checks.

Lin Yuan, with the authority delegated by the powerful Xia Qin, naturally encountered no obstructions along the way and directly reached the depths of the forbidden zone.

“This forbidden zone is also a terrifying ultimate weapon.”

Lin Yuan surveyed his surroundings, sensing a faint pressure.

“`

Very soon.

Lin Yuan arrived in front of a grand hall.

After passing the identity soul determination, Lin Yuan smoothly entered the hall.

From the outside, the hall didn’t appear very large, only a few dozen miles in radius.

But once Lin Yuan entered, he found himself in a vast world.

“That is?”

At first glance, Lin Yuan saw a body placed at the center of this world.

Compared to the projection in the virtual world, this body was even more realistic and detailed, with even the textures clearly visible.

At the same time.

A surging, ocean-like spiritual will came crashing down on Lin Yuan like a deluge.

“Uh?”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged. This spiritual will was far more powerful than the projection inside the virtual world, strong enough to destroy the will of a Level Eleven Evolver in a short time.

Even a Level Eleven Perfected Evolver wouldn’t last long in front of this body, and might even incur some irreversible damage afterwards.

But Lin Yuan?

It was no more than a spring breeze on his face.

With 334 million points of spiritual will index, not to mention just a body, even if this ultimate being were to come back to life, Lin Yuan was confident he could withstand it without using any other powers—as long as they didn’t use any other powers.

“The body of an ultimate being?”

Lin Yuan approached within ten meters, the best distance for observing the body.

Inside the virtual world, Lin Yuan could only see vague parts of the projection, but now, he could clearly see every detail within the flesh and blood of this body.

The skin of this body was crystal clear, with a faint layer of black membrane on the surface.

Lin Yuan observed deeper, magnifying the flesh and blood by a million times, only to find that the body was like a vast universe, each cell a vast star domain, with countless rules and essences flowing through the flesh like black demonic jade.

“Are these traces of cultivating the Demonic Jade Immortal Body?”

Lin Yuan was shocked. After becoming a Core Disciple of the Magic Jade Tower, Lin Yuan could choose one secret technique from many, including the Demonic Jade Immortal Body.

However, in the end, Lin Yuan chose “Illusionary Reality,” allowing his two Primordial Spirits to be no longer ineffective and possess strength close to his true body.

Lin Yuan made this choice not because the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” wasn’t strong, but because he needed the secret technique “Phantasm Reality” even more at that time.

“The cultivator of the ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’ has fallen?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that as a twelfth level body refining secret technique, the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” was probably at the same level as the “Body of Xuanhuang,” known for its life-preserving capability.

Even so, this ultimate being still perished.

Even after perishing, the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” within the flesh was broken through, otherwise, those few ultimate beings in the universe wouldn’t have been able to ‘dismember’ this ultimate being so easily.

Perfecting the “Body of Xuanhuang” to the twelfth level, one could withstand the collapse of the universe. The “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” was estimated to be almost at the same level.

Even if the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” wasn’t perfected, it shouldn’t be easy for a few ultimate beings to tear apart the flesh so effortlessly.

“Chaos Void…”

Lin Yuan’s expression became grave; within the universe, ultimate beings were absolutely invincible, and since the beginning of the universe, no ultimate being had been known to completely perish.

Even in the most brutal wars, they would at most be badly injured.

But outside the universe, in the Chaos Void, ultimate beings could die.

Probably only beings as powerful as the Xuanhuang or the Moyu Tower Master could traverse the Chaos Void with impunity.

“Contemplate.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, and as he faced this body directly, insights that were once stagnant flooded into his mind again.

[Your understanding defies the heavens. By observing the mysterious body, new demonic evolution pathways have been comprehended…]

…

As Lin Yuan continued to contemplate, a large number of new demonic evolution pathways were revealed.

“Can I try directly comprehending the ‘Demonic Jade Immortal Body’?” In the midst of contemplation, the idea suddenly flashed through Lin Yuan’s mind.

Having the “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” placed alongside “Illusionary Reality,” its level of preciousness need not be stated.

Since there were traces of “Demonic Jade Immortal Body” cultivation left in this body, with Lin Yuan’s against-heaven’s understanding, it was entirely possible to comprehend a part of it.

Even if he couldn’t comprehend the complete Demonic Jade Immortal Body, just comprehending a part of it would be immensely profitable.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan casually chatted with evolvers like the Black Star Lord, Lustrous Star Master, and others.

Preceding his breakthrough to the eleventh level, Lin Yuan primarily focused on adjusting his state, with cultivation being secondary.

“How is your cultivation going recently, Galaxy Master?” the Black Star Lord asked Lin Yuan with a smile.

As a grade-A tenth rank, the Black Star Lord had taken the initiative to establish a good rapport with Lin Yuan before he stepped into the tenth rank, showing great regard for the Galaxy Master.

“Not bad.”

Lin Yuan responded.

“Black Star Lord has already comprehended the second realm of pillar-level fusion rules and is probably soon to challenge for Level Eleven,” interjected the Lustrous Star Master who couldn’t help but speak.

After comprehending the second realm of pillar-level fusion rules, one could challenge for Level Eleven in as little as ten years or at most a few hundred years.

“Congratulations.”

Upon hearing this, Lin Yuan immediately offered his congratulations.

For any tenth rank evolver, advancing to Level Eleven was the most significant achievement, without exception.

After all, becoming a twelfth rank ultimate being… for almost all eleventh rank evolvers, was an unattainable ultimate goal.

“Hahaha.”

The Black Star Lord’s face lit up with a smile, looking at Lin Yuan, he said, “Galaxy Master, with your talent, it’s only a matter of time before you step into Level Eleven.”

“I’ll just break through ahead and wait for you at Level Eleven.”
